key_insight: Combining infrared-feedback laser power control with simulation-guided external cooling extended continuous epitaxial growth in L-DED CMSX-4 rods to nearly twice the height achieved with process control alone.
engineering_relevance: Improved heat extraction supports taller single-crystal superalloy builds, while optimized heat treatment reduced solutionizing time by 47%.
method: Dynamically adjust laser power using in-situ infrared thermal feedback.
Apply simulation-guided external cooling to stabilize solidification conditions.
Optimize post-build heat treatment and compare aged microstructures with Bridgman-processed material.
evidence_signal: EBSD validated continuous single-crystal growth, near-constant primary dendritic arm spacing indicated steady solidification, and aged samples showed precipitate distributions similar to Bridgman-processed material.
watch_item: The abstract demonstrates cylindrical rods; transfer to complex geometries and resulting mechanical performance remain unestablished.
paper_title: Bulk CMSX-4 Single-Crystal Builds via Laser-Directed Energy Deposition: Epitaxial Stability and Microstructure Evolution
